_comment: Tile -> pixel transform per map image. The art is not a plain render of the
ROM map: DarkmoonEX's maps are hand-composited, so some images place parts of
a floor independently and iceB3 carries two floors side by side. That is why a
map can need more than one region. 'rows' bounds a region by ROM tile row,
inclusive; the first matching region wins, and a region with no bounds matches
everything. Every offset here was verified by finding the drawn chest sprites
in the art and checking the overlay by eye -- see tools/overlay_preview.py.
